doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

people.name: Euodia
people.line: Christian woman in Philippi; urged by Paul to reconcile.

people.name: Syntyche
people.line: Woman in the Philippian church whom Paul exhorted

translations.web: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
translations.bsb: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
translations.kjv: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
translations.asv: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to be of the same mind in the Lord.
